en: A black-and-white street scene showing a large formal parade proceeding down a cobblestone main street lined with wooden commercial buildings and awnings. Soldiers in uniform march in formation behind several men on horseback; at least one carries a large U.S. flag. Crowds in early-20th‑century dress pack both sidewalks and storefronts, many wearing straw boaters or wide‑brimmed hats. Overhead are telegraph/telephone wires and some bunting and flags decorating the buildings. The image is framed in a way typical of a photographic postcard.
